rationale: Order repeals paragraphs 153-154 and rewrites paragraph 152 (two-year passport expiry) of the 1896-97 consular instructions/regulations. Held passport rules (EO 235 of 1903, EO 654 of 1907, which restate the two-year expiry) were issued later and the chain runs to a June 7, 1911 order, so the amended paragraphs were likely replaced; but no held text expressly revokes or supersedes EO 135 or says the 1896-97 paragraph numbering survived. Editorial 'Supersedes' notes are not an express act and do not name 135. Not established. Source is a compiled transcription (acceptable_as_original: false): original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Text of EO 181 (1902) and the June 7, 1911 order, or any text expressly superseding the 1896/97 regulations and EO 135
A held current passport regulation predicate
